symptoms: You will see a white powdery fungal growth on leaves, flowers, and young fruits.
Young leaves may show patches that turn purplish brown.
Infected flowers and fruits often drop off the tree before they grow.
The disease can prevent fruits from setting on the tree.
favourable_conditions: Rains or mists along with cooler nights during the flowering stage help the disease spread.
prevention: Monitor your trees regularly for signs of the disease.
Check the health of your trees during the flowering season.
practices: Remove and destroy the parts of the plant that show signs of infection.
Keep a close watch on your trees to catch the disease early.
